text:
Maya Chen: Morning — quick async standup. Onboarding llama3 variant into the spanish promptset (branch feature/llama3-spanish-fixes). Ran a 1k-sample eval and seeing a repeatable tokenization/detokenization mismatch causing date-format hallucinations + some stopword stripping. Blocker: need another pair of eyes on tokenizer config before we gate. Today: try a tokenizer patch, post prompt tweak PR, and prepare canary config for rollout.

Samir Patel: I can take a look in ~30m. which branch?

Maya Chen: branch=feature/llama3-spanish-fixes. Short log snippet: ```diff
- "enero 1"
+ "enero uno"
``` Not exact matches — looks like unicode normalization / preproc is changing token boundaries. Also saw latency tail increase on xpu-2 for long-context with batch=8 smoke.

Jonah Ruiz: I'll run a focused eval sweep (100 samples) and push results to the eval dashboard. FYI saw a quantization artifact on a similar model last week — could be related.

Priya Nair: quick Q — is this gating for Hosted only or do Dedicated customers get hit? Need to flag support if Dedicated models are involved.

Maya Chen: Hosted + Dedicated both *could* be affected; Dedicated customers with pinned model versions won't see changes unless they opt into the new variant. I'll add a short note in the rollout docs. Tagging Luca for infra canary help.

Luca Bianchi: infra can spin up canary pool, but I need the canary YAML (max 5% traffic, fallback rules, health checks). Paste the config and I can stage it. Also I'll check node metrics for xpu-2 latency spike.

Samir Patel: quick code ping — left an inline comment on PR 482 about tokenizer util. Suspect default normalize form. Small potential fix: switch `NFKC` -> `NFD` in preproc and re-run tokenization unit tests.

deploy-bot: New eval run 3305001245 completed for model llama3-xxlq-miniq — results: pass=86 fail=14. Link: https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/3305001245

Jonah Ruiz: uploaded the CSV to the eval drive (https://drive.redwood/internal/evals/3305001245.csv). Failing cases cluster around dates, punctuation, and Spanish stopword edge-cases.

Priya Nair: I'll draft a short support note describing the regression, affected endpoints, and mitigation steps. Will share for review.

Maya Chen: action items: Samir opens tokenizer PR + unit tests; Jonah runs the canary recipe + uploads full eval; Luca validates canary YAML + watches xpu nodes; Priya drafts support note. I'll land prompt tweak after Samir's change. Ping if anyone gets blocked. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: :thumbsup: on it, aiming to have PR up by EOD.

Luca Bianchi: :eyes: will report node findings before EOD.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled at 2023-11-02T15:30Z for job canary-llama3-spanish (id:c-9832).

Maya Chen: added `gated: true` flag to the canary metadata in model config. Will post rollout metrics in the noon report and follow up if regressions persist. Thanks everyone!
